text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
"That was a truly fantastic run!!
Congratulations on 1st place!!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I actually managed to pull it off, didn't I...?
Really... me...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, thank you for your cheers!
I was only able to win thanks to all of you...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Members of the Mejiro family, are you watching...?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I won...!!
As an umamusume of the Mejiro family, I saw it through to the end!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"While I was running, everyone's faces
kept coming to mind... and so—!!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
And that's how I managed to win...!!
Thank you so, so much...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen expressing her gratitude
to the Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Seeing that, the crowd's cheers continued unbroken for quite some time.
